messages:
maria: seeing a sudden p99 jump in us-west after last runtime rollout, p95 stable but p99 went from ~220ms -> 1.6-1.9s for longseq chat workloads
cheng: digging through traces now — top hotspot is attention kernel, specifically time spent in sdpa path for seq_len>4096, queues/backlog also spike
sasha: customer Acme hit SLA alerts, opened ticket #7832 — they reported interactive chat timeouts around 1.5s. any recent changes?
kevin: rolled sdpa default + new compile flags to improve throughput (attempted vectorization) at ~02:50 UTC. flags: `-march=native -O3 -ftree-vectorize -funsafe-math-optimizations`
alex: can we toggle fallback to flashattn for affected models until we root-cause? customers are impacted
deploy-bot: deploy completed: sdpa-compileflags v2 to 30% -> 100% in region us-west at 02:57 UTC
maria: correlation looks tight. quick repro: synthetic load with seq_len 512/2048/8192 shows p99 climbs dramatically with sdpa v2. attaching a minimal repro snippet:
```
# repro pseudo
for L in [512,2048,8192]:
  run_load(model="gptx-7b", seq_len=L, qps=20, duration=120)
  report_p95_p99()
```
kevin: reproduced locally on A100 clusters. vectorization increases instruction-level cache pressure and causes more memstore stalls on KV writes for longseq; net effect higher latency for p99 despite better throughput for shorter seqs
cheng: immediate mitigation: enable kernel fallback policy for routes with seq_len>4096 to `flashattn` until we ship a fix. that should drop p99 back to normal
sasha: can someone flip the override? runbook command?
kevin: running now: `redwood runtime set-kernel --model gptx-7b --region us-west --kernel-preference flashattn --override-reason "p99 spike sdpa v2"`
deploy-bot: kernel override applied for gptx-* in us-west at 03:25 UTC
alex: confirmed with Acme — latency improved, p99 down to ~240ms. support notified and asked for their validation. :thumbsup:
maria: follow-up: need a bisect to identify which compile flag triggers regression. primary suspects: `-ftree-vectorize`, `-funsafe-math-optimizations`
kevin: plan: run matrix of builds: baseline, +vectorize, +unsafe-math, both; run microbench on attention kernels + end-to-end longseq flows. will prepare patch to disable vectorize for longseq optimized builds if repro holds
cheng: add temporary alert: attention-kernel p99 > 500ms for routes where typical seq_len > 1024; mark as sev2 and page on repeat violations
sasha: creating postmortem stub, linking ticket #7832 and the rollback details. assign owners for bisect and patch
alex: logging customer comms and SLA notes in the ticket; will follow-up when kevin posts perf matrix
kevin: update: running bisect now, will post perf numbers + PR by EOD. next steps: patch build flags, canary, monitor p99 across regions
maria: good work. once patch validated, do staged rollout and re-evaluate kernel heuristics (we might need heuristics to prefer flashattn for longseq until sdpa build is safe)
